title: 腾讯高管：算力成本高企，AI经济账靠什么算平？
speaker: Dawson Tong

segments.en: And here's my exclusive conversation with Dawson Tong. The CapEx has been pretty sizable for pretty much most players.
segments.zh: 以下是我与Dawson Tong的独家对话。大多数参与者的资本支出都相当可观。

segments.en: But the demand is also very strong. I think right now, if you look at the five-layer stack as Jensen like to describe,
segments.zh: 但需求也非常强劲。我认为现在，如果看Jensen喜欢描述的五层堆栈，

segments.en: majority of the profits shift downward, right?
segments.zh: 大部分利润向下转移，对吧？

segments.en: So if we can get the same compute at a lower cost and maybe the equation would work just fine, especially
segments.zh: 所以如果我们能以更低成本获得相同算力，也许等式就能成立，尤其是

segments.en: as we see agents being deployed in copper environments as well as consumers using AI more and more in the daily life,
segments.zh: 随着智能体部署到更多环境，以及消费者在日常生活中越来越多地使用AI，

segments.en: we do believe the value created by AI is tremendous.
segments.zh: 我们确实相信AI创造的价值是巨大的。

segments.en: So I'm sure we'll figure out a way to make the economics work.
segments.zh: 所以我确信我们会找到方法让经济模型成立。

segments.en: Do you feel though that Tencent is sort of playing catch-up
segments.zh: 不过你觉得腾讯是否在某种程度上处于追赶状态？
